plan.p0: Mechanism: Scan every 3×3 window and recolor to 1 the union of windows whose nine cells are 0. Distinguishing assumption: every exact all-zero 3×3 occurrence counts, including overlaps and occurrences inside larger blank areas.
plan.p1: Mechanism: Find maximal axis-aligned all-zero rectangles with both dimensions at least 3, and recolor their blank cells to 1. Distinguishing assumption: marking follows whole blank rectangles, so larger rectangles may be filled beyond the cells covered by individual 3×3 windows.
plan.p2: Mechanism: Identify connected zero-components that contain a 3×3 all-zero square, then recolor only the component’s cells that lie in at least one such square. Distinguishing assumption: connectivity links candidate squares, but zero tails outside every qualifying square remain unchanged.
plan.p3: Mechanism: Recolor only isolated, non-overlapping all-zero 3×3 squares, choosing a deterministic scan-order placement when candidates overlap. Distinguishing assumption: overlapping candidates compete rather than all contributing their union; this agrees where the observed marked regions admit such a selection.
